{{Top|leg}}
'''Mekebve spores''' were allergens that were debilitating and potentially [[Death/Legends|fatal]] to the [[Mammal/Legends|mammalian]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. [[Reptile/Legends|Reptilian]] species, such as the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] were unaffected.
